name: flop-docs-sentinel
description: Machine-readable change feed for FLOP protocol documentation and the yellowpaper repo. Poll feed.json; items appear when rendered docs pages, the latest YP commit, or YP issue activity change.
consumer_notes: Served as static files from GitHub Pages; no auth, no cookies, no token. Default python-urllib User-Agent was re-tested on 2026-09-30 and returns 200 on feed.json and agent.json, so the earlier 403-with-default-UA caveat is withdrawn: it applied to the retired Cloudflare-fronted path (dash.0xcharles.com/sentinel/), which now 404s.
feed.json is a bounded list of the most recent events; poll it every poll_seconds_recommended. feed.xml carries the same items for RSS consumers, index.html is the human view.
Every item carries a url and observed timestamp; events are append-only across rebuilds and are also kept locally in events.jsonl.

source_of_truth.conflict: ask.flop.finance/docs still publishes intro-era figures: miner share 90%, era-0 miner pool 86.4 FLOP/block, testnet miner pool 993,384,000 FLOP. The hosted Yellow Paper has 75/10/10/5 and 1,200,000,000 cohorts. Issue #54 closed with the hosted Yellow Paper named authoritative; the GitHub mirror was synced at 3c97bbc.
